title: An Empirical Analysis on Large Language Models in Debate Evaluation
reasoning: The paper investigates the capabilities and structural biases (positional, lexical, and order biases) of LLMs acting as judges in debate evaluation. While the provided sample debate in the appendix (Tables 13-15) focuses on atheism, theism, and the source of morality, the research itself benchmarks the models' mechanical evaluation performance and reliability rather than their understanding of religious or ethical frameworks.
